authorization: Continue the partition-function explanation with the smallest in-scope comparison after raw activity truncation becomes too broad at L5,p=.08.
question: Can an exact positive transfer sum over the two-current defect gas tighten the certified LER upper bound beyond the global activity tail?
design_role: Prerequisite discriminating test for the positive-transfer branch. It runs before a more elaborate connected-polymer resummation because failure of this strongest simple positive relaxation would reject that relaxation without tuning a truncation order.

frozen_model.physical_channel: Same canonical open square, ternary independent current prior, full interior integer charge, unmeasured rough endpoints and binary logical parity as the completed activity contract.
frozen_model.pair_field: For two currents j0,j1, delta=j0-j1. Enforce D delta=0 at every measured vertex and odd relative logical parity. Each pair has positive weight sqrt(P(j0)P(j1)).
frozen_model.upper_bound: For every Q, min(Z0,Z1)<=sqrt(Z0 Z1)<=sum_{j0 in sector0,j1 in sector1,same Q} sqrt(P(j0)P(j1)). Summing Q gives the positive defect-transfer upper bound U_pair.
frozen_model.baseline: Completed k=4 activity lower/upper interval from results/current-activity-expansion-2026-09-18.json.
frozen_model.uncertainty: None: deterministic transfer contraction and exact algebraic bounds.

acceptance: All transfer weights are nonnegative; every measured delta charge is exactly zero; frontier closes; and exact L3 LER never exceeds min(1/2,U_pair) beyond 1e-12.
Compare the registered activity upper bound with min(activity upper,U_pair) on every L5 cell. Promote the pair transfer only where it strictly reduces width by at least 10%.
If it improves no p=.08 cell, reject this positive pair relaxation and do not enlarge size or tune a polymer cutoff in this contract.
No threshold, phase, CFT, decoder or midpoint-estimate claim.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen L3 gate and L5 p=.05,.08 matrix. Failure is a branch rejection and directs the next contract toward a sharper sector/Hellinger contraction or a controlled connected-cluster expansion.
decision: Reject the configuration-level positive pair relaxation. It improves none of the eight L5 cells; at p=.08 its capped upper bounds are .5,.5,.5,.26273 versus activity bounds .13836,.12506,.11404,.10877.
next_action: Register a sharper sector-level Hellinger/TV contraction or a controlled connected-cluster expansion; do not enlarge the rejected pair-transfer matrix.
